title: Every client bundle matches its source after shared tracy-core publish code changed: the bundles gate passes
steps: S1: After pnpm dsh:build and pnpm install, run pnpm exec tsx scripts/check-all.ts --only bundles.
expect: S1: the gate prints that all packages match their source and exits 0; tracy-sidebar, tracy-settings, tracy-design-inspiration, tracy-my-sites, tracy-model-plan and tracy-onboard are not listed as stale.
evidence: After #131 (ed1d742dc) every PR based on develop failed the bundles gate on these six packages; on 2de804b3b it passed.
